## Execution tips

- Confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the car body and pads can contact it before closing. If unclear, adjust position or viewing angle rather than assuming enclosure from image overlap.
- The display stand has a raised rim. Leave clearance for wheels and fingers to cross it when approaching the surface. If the car needs rotation, adjust above the stand where space permits to reduce sweeping collisions or pushing the stand.
- Keep the car wheels facing down during placement, and release only after they are supported by the stand surface. Withdraw the fingers upward to reduce the risk of dropping it while suspended or dragging it sideways.
